item.title: Helen Fire burns west of Wagon Mound
item.description: MORA COUNTY, N.M. (KRQE) – The Mora County Sheriff's Office said a wildfire broke out west of Wagon Mound. The Helen Fire has burned around 1,180 acres and is 50% contained. Forward progress was stopped. Highway 120 was shut down Tuesday evening but has since reopened.

item.title: Temperatures will feel more like March again by the end of this week
item.description: Temperatures cool slightly through Wednesday across New Mexico, but the warmth is far from over. Windy weather returns Thursday before a stronger cold front moves in late Thursday night. It was another unseasonably warm day across the state, with highs climbing into the 60s, 70s, and 80s.
